scope: Step1: common history-query boundary with adapters for unchanged exact C replay and legacy rolling history. Step2: bounded representation comparison harness. No new compressor, solver rewrite, full-history canonical replay or aging implementation.

EstimateView.meaning: A solver query result, never a new observation or replacement historical evidence.
fields: provider identity and owned source intervals
EstimateView.not_sufficient: Different histories can have the same optimum, or the same optimum and local curvature, but different likelihood away from it and different future implications.

HistoryMessage.meaning: Authoritative conditional evidence and physical transport, independent of chosen optimizer.
fields: likelihood or explicitly declared profile/marginal semantics
HistoryMessage.prior_ownership: Adapters return likelihood only; original prior remains separate once. Solver outputs never appended as observations.

operators.identity: Zero observations, zero likelihood, identity physical transport.
operators.append: Inject one validated chronological observation and its input/state propagation once.
operators.compose: Only adjacent disjoint source intervals with matching model/calibration, state epochs and parameter chart may compose. Source mismatch, overlap, gap and contract mismatch reject.
operators.deterministic_rule: Phi_AB=Phi_B o Phi_A; L_AB=L_A+L_B o Phi_A. Parameters are included in the transport domain and carried unchanged in stationary mode.
operators.domain_rule: D_AB=D_A intersect Phi_A^(-1)(D_B). Candidate validity across the whole path cannot be inferred from a final endpoint alone.
operators.query: Read-only evaluation at a candidate. Query must not advance physical time, consume observations or mutate authoritative history.
operators.rechart: Allowed only with a valid coefficient conversion and declared error. Moving a query point does not change stored evidence.
operators.aging: General boundary kernels compose by integrating over the shared physical/health state for marginal semantics; min-plus composition defines a different profile objective. Deterministic algebra alone does not solve stochastic aging.
laws: associativity of exact mathematical ordered composition
operators.limits: Exact associative function composition does not prove a finite representation closes. Ordinary float associativity is not exact. Existing compact-bank append does not implement a new generic block-compose operator.

implementation.exact_adapter: provider.c calls unchanged desktop_eval and packs its GN matrix.
implementation.compact_adapter: provider.c queries a desktop scratch copy of unchanged re_context using re_query(...,1,0). It never mutates the owned bank, state, counters or workspace.
implementation.construction: Fabricated append and atomic commit-at-query controls call unchanged re_offer/re_admit/re_commit. The moving query schedule is a representation-only diagnostic, not causal optimization.
implementation.production_integration: re_refine, its prior, step selection and commit policy remain unchanged. A generic callback has not yet been wired into the production optimizer; adapter tests precede that refactor.
implementation.memory: This harness is desktop-only and deliberately uses extra scratch and stored observations. The8680B context is the old candidate, not proof that adapters or a future provider fit10240B.

qualification.nodes: public mean and plus/minus0.1publicSD on each original coordinate, frozen before evaluations
qualification.stimuli: Fabricated ADC12 voltage codes, positive/zero/negative currents and jittered actual intervals. No plant/fit truth or saved canonical inputs.
controls: raw-block exact/compact costs gradients GN endpoints
exact adapter bitwise match to native desktop_eval
read-only query bytes and ownership before/after commit
legacy representation discrepancy census without asserting compaction fidelity

numeric_parity.scope: Finite host cross-path regression allowance, not a physical noise threshold or forward-error proof.

finite_difference.scope: Finite derivative check, not confidence calibration.

qualification.next_gate: Read measured representation discrepancies. A separate representation must demonstrate closure, original-model fidelity and complete bytes/work feasibility before the four-hour solver comparison; aging follows a specified transition/semantics.

complex_analysis.promising: For the frozen linear RC part, Z_RC(s)=R0+sum_i R_i/(1+s*tau_i) describes stable real-negative poles and nonnegative RC residues. Rational/complex-domain tools may provide compact response bases and approximation diagnostics.
complex_analysis.caution: This transfer function is not the full historical likelihood. It omits state initialization, observation values, nonlinear OCV, switching/history-dependent hysteresis and aging. A nonconstant real-valued likelihood is not generally a holomorphic function of complexified parameters. Complex coordinates do not recover information discarded in a point estimate.
complex_analysis.testable_question: Can a fixed passive/stable rational or other response basis retain original-model transport and likelihood contrasts with fewer complete live bytes/work than the moving polynomial, across declared nuisance ranges and actual intervals?
criteria: fixed representation selected before evidence is discarded
preserved chronological input forcing and boundary dependence
stability/passivity where implied by the model
no new unobserved model dynamics hidden by rational fitting
complex_analysis.geometry: Use distinguishability of physical response/evidence on declared candidate and continuation domains as the proposed geometric notion. Separate this from solver GN geometry and from Bayesian posterior uncertainty. No SCM/NAIA/D2 proof claim.

primary_reference.title: Nakatsukasa, Sète, Trefethen: The AAA algorithm for rational approximation
primary_reference.supports: Rational approximation on real/complex sampled domains; not a battery history-compression guarantee.
